title: DBCOLOR EED source dependency binding and selected graph readback
scope: Bind captured DBCOLOR EED APPID/LAYER references to immutable original name records and unique current table rows, then exercise selected ACAD_COLOR graph projection separately from complete-drawing conversion.

implementation.baseline: An import-time deep DBCOLOR copy is private to the adapter source sidecar; its variant pointees cannot be reached through the public read-only sidecar view. Its retention is charged to the existing bounded EED-source allowance.
implementation.validation: The source-only preflight checks unchanged DBCOLOR common fields and EED, raw frame identity/class/common owner/reactors, unique matched source and live APPID/LAYER rows with unchanged original DWG name provenance, all required EED reference indices and role/value coverage, and bounded temporary index memory. Missing, aliased, changed and unresolved dependencies refuse before the existing DBCOLOR output gate.
implementation.outputBoundary: This preflight proves source dependency consistency only. It never qualifies or enables DBCOLOR complete graph output; independent DWG-to-DXF fallback mapping, emitted-source proof and native semantics remain open.

physicalWitness.sourceBindings: NOD 0xC -> ACAD_COLOR 0x6B -> RAL CLASSIC$RAL 7047 color 0x369B0; color owner/reactor 0x6B; EED source APPID handle 0x12 -> ACAD; no layer reference; 13 repeated four-value tuples.
physicalWitness.selectedProjection: For ASCII and Binary DXF, a selected graph emitted the original dictionary, the DBCOLOR and all 53 original XDATA values; fresh readback matched NOD and dictionary entries, owner/reactor, APPID name, RGB/name and every XDATA value. Other original drawing objects are deliberately excluded, so this is not whole-file conversion.

generatedControls: A locally authored AC1027 source has one DBCOLOR with both APPID and LAYER EED references. The dependency validator rejects edits to the EED, source fallback, live APPID/LAYER names, duplicate table rows, wrong source APPID handle and duplicated reference index, then accepts restored source data. ASCII/Binary selected graph controls reject an out-of-domain 1070 value of 65536 without replacing the existing destination and retry successfully using the same dxfRW writer, followed by fresh typed graph readback.
compatibility: No DRW_Interface or DRW_DbColor layout change is introduced. Compile-time controls verify callers cannot obtain the private baseline or assign source reference handles through the const sidecar view. This is not a general ABI or native-application certification.

validation.result: PASS; source dependency binding, selected graph rollback/retry and exact EED readback in ASCII and Binary, with complete output still refused.

residual1070.observation: A value of 40000 is accepted by the generic 16-bit DXF writer, but binary DXF reader interprets the same 16-bit pattern as -25536. This can affect exact typed-value preservation for values 32768-65535. The unrelated selected-profile source value 254 is unaffected.

conflictingAuthorities.title: Autodesk About Extended Data
conflictingAuthorities.statement: Describes the same 16-bit integer as signed or unsigned.

residual1070.nextAction: Determine the intended API/raw-bit contract and add a loss-aware output/readback policy without treating either conflicting description as universal.

limitations: The selected output deliberately omits unrelated original drawing objects and does not prove full conversion, independent kernel interpretation, or source DWG CMC-to-DXF 62 fallback.
The APPID/LAYER reference capture follows existing parser chunk coalescing and is not an original raw wire-chunk inventory.
The ODA resave and subsequent ODA DXF each reduced repeated original EED tuple count, as recorded separately; neither is used as lossless source proof.
The physical source and generated output files remain uncommitted.
